name: branding-kids-and-teens-supplement-campaign-portraits
title: Split portraits of a teen and a child with packaging on saturated purple and orange
whatItIs: A split image: on purple, a smiling teen in a violet tee holds a red gummy beside a tub; on orange, a child stacks four coloured tubs of different flavours into a tall tower and looks up at it.
whatItMeans: Warm, cheerful and honest; saturated backgrounds match each product line and the tower shows the range as play.
techniques: Colour the whole backdrop to match the product line.
Use real people with natural expressions.
Stack packaging into a tower to show the whole range.
Split the frame into two portraits for contrast.

vocabulary.definition: A background tuned to the packaging hue.
Product stacked to show the full line.
Two images side by side in one frame.
A lit photo against a plain backdrop.
